question: What desire is expressed by the speaker concerning an auspicious account of the deception practiced by time?
premises: The speaker expresses a wish now.
The object of that wish is to hear something.
That something is characterized as the auspicious deception of time.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear an auspicious teaching concerning the deception of time.
uncertainties: The content of that deception is not revealed in this verse.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
